# Turbulence — Fluids

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “holographic turbulence”).

claims.name: numerical_simulation_shows_egb_holographic
claims.statement: Numerical simulation shows that EGB holographic turbulence has qualitative features similar to Einstein-gravity holographic turbulence.

sources.title: Holographic Turbulence in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity at Large $D$

claims.name: forced_fluid_flows_exhibit_turbulence
claims.statement: Forced fluid flows can exhibit turbulence, making holographic duals of forced fluid dynamics particularly relevant for steady-state turbulence.

sources.title: Forced Fluid Dynamics from Gravity in Arbitrary Dimensions

claims.name: scaling_power_laws_scalar_driven
claims.statement: The scaling power laws of scalar driven holographic turbulence agree with previous simulations of two-dimensional turbulence in compressible fluids.

sources.title: Holographic Turbulence and Numerical Estimate of the Fractal Dimension of the Turbulent Horizon

claims.name: holographic_duality_provides_systematic_approach
claims.statement: Holographic duality provides a systematic approach to studying quantum turbulence

sources.title: Holographic Vortex Liquids and Superfluid Turbulence

claims.name: holographic_superfluid_turbulence_vortex_cluster
claims.statement: In holographic superfluid turbulence, vortex cluster formation is driven by quantum dissipation properties unique to the holographic system.

sources.title: Emergence of Large-Scale Structures in Holographic Superfluid Turbulence

claims.name: local_energy_dissipation_local_fluid
claims.statement: The local energy dissipation and the local fluid velocity distribution provide measures of holographic fluid turbulence.

sources.title: Holographic Turbulence From a Random Gravitational Potential

claims.name: gaussbonnet_term_contributes_two_extra
claims.statement: The Gauss-Bonnet term contributes two extra terms in the equations of motion whose effect on holographic turbulence is analyzed.

sources.title: Holographic Turbulence in Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity at Large $D$

claims.name: observed_patterns_match_holographic_superfluid
claims.statement: The observed patterns match holographic superfluid at the standard quantization and suggest universal features for quantum turbulence at temperatures order of the critical temperature.

sources.title: Towards Quantum Turbulence in Finite Temperature Bose-Einstein Condensates

claims.name: weak_turbulence_mesons_found_meson
claims.statement: A weak turbulence of mesons is found at a meson melting transition in holographic QCD with critical embeddings of probe D-branes in gravity duals.

sources.title: Universal turbulence on branes in holography

claims.name: paper_proposes_holographic_scheme_studying
claims.statement: The paper proposes a holographic scheme for studying pattern formation in $1+1$-dimensional reaction-diffusion systems via the dynamics of a neutral complex scalar field in a $2+1$-dimensional black hole background. Within this setup it realizes plane waves, defect turbulence, phase turbulence, spatiotemporal intermittency, and coherent structures, and derives a phase diagram from plane-wave instability that identifies the holographic Benjamin-Feir-Newell instability.

claims.name: authors_implement_alternative_quantization_dynamical
claims.statement: The authors implement alternative quantization in a dynamical holographic superfluid and conduct long-time stable numerical simulations to investigate quantum turbulence in finite-temperature Bose-Einstein condensates. By observing two-body vortex decay, Kolmogorov scaling, and a direct energy cascade, they suggest that these patterns reflect universal features of quantum turbulence near the critical temperature.

sources.title: Towards Quantum Turbulence in Finite Temperature Bose-Einstein Condensates

claims.name: paper_also_finds_decay_rate
claims.statement: The paper also finds that the decay rate near the critical temperature agrees with the recently developed effective theory of 2D superfluid turbulence, linking the holographic dynamics to the effective description.

sources.title: Holographic Thermal Relaxation in Superfluid Turbulence

claims.name: paper_further_shows_alpha_mesonturbulence
claims.statement: The paper further shows that the $\alpha=-5$ meson-turbulence scaling is universal across multiple routes to deconfinement, including near-critical static electric fields, electric-field quenches, and quark-mass quenches. This identifies a common spectral signature of the deconfinement transition in the holographic setup.

sources.title: Meson turbulence at quark deconfinement from AdS/CFT

claims.name: holographic_correspondence_used_study_ensembleaveraged
claims.statement: The holographic correspondence is used to study the ensemble-averaged energy-momentum tensor in a stochastic gravitational background; numerically solving the associated Einstein equations and mapping to the boundary theory reveals that the non-relativistic energy power spectrum exhibits Kolmogorov-Kraichnan power-law behavior, connecting gravity and turbulence.

claims.name: stifffluid_cosmologies_rho_including_holographic
claims.statement: For stiff-fluid cosmologies with $p=\rho$, including the Holographic Universe, the paper computes scalar and tensor perturbations without a microphysical model and finds a scale-invariant spectrum only for modes deep inside the Hubble horizon, while infrared modes acquire oscillatory and logarithmic distortions. It also shows that growing vector perturbations can drive turbulence and anisotropy, implying that any post-holographic inflationary phase cannot be much shorter than in standard inflation.

sources.title: Perturbations in a Holographic Universe and in Other Stiff Fluid Cosmologies

claims.name: paper_demonstrates_vortex_clusters_inverse
claims.statement: The paper demonstrates that vortex clusters and inverse energy cascades emerge near absolute zero in a holographic superfluid turbulence model based on a near-extreme Reissner-Nordstr$\ddot{o}$m black hole. This formation is driven by unique quantum dissipation properties involving the near immobilization of vortex dipoles, distinguishing it from conventional quantum fluids.

sources.title: Emergence of Large-Scale Structures in Holographic Superfluid Turbulence

claims.name: holographic_duality_provides_systematic_framework
claims.statement: Holographic duality provides a systematic framework for simulating the decaying (<math display="inline"><mrow><mn>3</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math>)-dimensional quantum turbulence by numerically solving the dual Abelian-Higgs theory in a (<math display="inline"><mrow><mn>4</mn><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></math>)-dimensional black hole background.

sources.title: Dissipation and Decay of Three Dimensional Holographic Quantum Turbulence

claims.name: largespatialdimension_limit_paper_shows_relativistic
claims.statement: In the large-spatial-dimension limit, the paper shows that relativistic hydrodynamics simplifies under certain restrictions, and that large-$D$ holographic theories obey these restrictions so their dynamics are captured by a naturally truncated hydrodynamic derivative expansion. It then uses analytic and numerical studies of two- and three-dimensional turbulence to connect the resulting fluid flows to geometric data.

sources.title: Holographic Turbulence in a Large Number of Dimensions
